title: spec-dna.toml
description: The project configuration of spec-dna. spec-dna reads it as TOML. See docs/config.md.

spec-dna.description: The pinned spec-dna version. `check` does not run with a binary of another version.

exclude.description: Repository path globs that are never documents (vendored or generated text). Links to them still resolve as files.

self-urls.description: URL prefixes that address this repository. A link under one of them resolves as a path from the repository root. `*` is one whole path segment, such as a branch.

install-source.description: The git source of spec-dna for `cargo install --git`, such as `file:///srv/git/spec-dna` or `ssh://git@host/team/spec-dna.git`. The message of a version mismatch uses it. Default: the public repository.

roots.description: Directories of documents. A path belongs to the deepest root that contains it.

budgets.description: Size budgets in Unicode characters of body text, per document type.

max-words.description: The maximum number of words in a requirement sentence. A longer sentence causes a warning. Default 30.

budget.description: The default character budget of `spec-dna context`. Default 12000.

repos.description: Aliases of other repositories for `<repo>:<namespace>/<slug>` references.

pattern.description: Literal text with exactly one `{n}` (one or more digits). `*` matches any text.

path.description: Directory relative to the repository root. Use `.` for the whole repository.

type.description: The type of every document in the root. With `mixed` (the default), the front matter of each document gives the type.

default-type.description: For mixed roots only: the type of a document that has no `type` field. Default `note`.

status.description: The status of a document that has the default type of the root and no `status` field.

exclude.description: Globs relative to the root that are not documents.

legacy-ids.description: Patterns that make aliases from existing file names, such as `ADR-{n}`.

legacy-keys.description: Patterns of existing requirement keys that spec-dna keeps as written, such as `R-{n}`.

status-map.description: Legacy status words, each with the status that it maps to, such as `released = "active"`. The target must be a status of the root's type, or of any type in a mixed root.

required-sections.description: For each type, the headings of its required section. A document of that type needs one of them (SD305). spec-dna compares them without case. A list replaces the default of its type. The default is `decision = ["Decision Outcome", "Decision"]`; the other types have no required section. An empty list removes the required section. For a decision, `context` serves this section as the summary.

amendment-sections.description: For each type, the names of its amendment sections, in any language. A heading of level 2 or more starts an amendment section if it is a name, or if it starts with a name and a character that is not a letter or a digit. spec-dna compares them without case. The section continues to the next heading of the same or a higher level. A list replaces the default of its type. The default is `decision = ["Amendments"]`. After a decision is accepted, the text outside its amendment sections is frozen (SD405). For a decision, `context` serves the amendment sections with the outcome.

enforce-budgets.description: If false, a document over its hard budget gives the warning SD704, never the error SD702. Default true.

lint-severity.description: The severity of the requirement lint (SD801 to SD805) in this root. Default `warning`.

drift-severity.description: The severity of the drift diagnostics (SD606, SD607) in this root. Default `warning`. With `error`, a change that removes or renames cited code fails `check`.
